title: Asian Markets Today: Nikkei 225, Kospi Rise As AI Optimism Lifts Tech Stocks
description: South Korea's Kospi gained nearly 3%, while Japan's Nikkei 225 advanced 1.4% as strong earnings from artificial intelligence-linked companies revived investor appetite for technology stocks. US equity futures also moved higher, while Brent crude traded near $109 a barrel amid uncertainty over efforts to end the US-Iran war.
